name: AI Marketing Expert — AI Email Marketing, Content Generator, SEO Analyzer, Workflow Automation, Social Media & Ai Chatbot
author: Noor Alam

sections.description:
AI Marketing Expert is the most complete AI-powered marketing suite for WordPress. Instead of paying for Mailchimp, Jasper, Semrush, Hootsuite, Intercom, and Zapier separately, you get all six — email marketing, content generation, SEO, social media, a live AI chatbot, and workflow automation — built right into your WordPress admin.

Powered by your choice of leading AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter), every module is designed to save you hours every week and help you grow your audience consistently without burnout.

The built-in SEO Analyzer module gives you AI-powered keyword research, on-page audits, rank tracking, and topical authority mapping — all without leaving WordPress.

🔗 View Plugin Website | 🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Whether you are a blogger, a small business owner, a WooCommerce store, or a freelancer managing client sites, AI Marketing Expert gives you enterprise-grade marketing automation at zero extra tool cost.

🎬 Watch The Setup Video

✅ Why AI Marketing Expert?

  • All-in-one — Six complete marketing tools in a single WordPress plugin
  • AI-native — Every module uses AI to write, optimize, and automate your marketing
  • Your AI, your keys — Connect OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or OpenRouter
  • Modular — Activate only the modules you need
  • Privacy-first — API keys encrypted at rest (AES-256), no third-party data sharing
  • Generous free tier — Real value without a subscription

👉 Upgrade to Pro to unlock unlimited everything.

📧 Email Marketing (Free + Pro)

A complete email CRM and campaign system built inside WordPress — no Mailchimp account needed.

Subscriber Management

  • Unlimited subscribers (Free)
  • Add, edit, bulk manage, and delete subscribers
  • Custom fields, tags, and list segmentation
  • Import from CSV, WordPress users, or WooCommerce customers
  • Full subscriber profile with activity history and notes
  • Public subscribe form via REST API

Campaigns

  • Create and schedule email campaigns (30/month Free, Unlimited Pro)
  • Choose recipients by list, tag, or audience segment
  • Track open rates, click rates, unsubscribes, and per-link click metrics
  • Live campaign progress monitoring

Email Automation & Drip Funnels

  • Multi-step drip/funnel sequences with triggers (2 funnels Free, Unlimited Pro)
  • Enroll and unenroll subscribers per funnel
  • Funnel performance metrics dashboard

Templates & AI Writing

  • Reusable HTML email templates with merge tag placeholders
  • Template preview renderer
  • Default templates ready to use on activation
  • AI-generated subject lines, preview text, and copy suggestions

SMTP & Sending

  • Multi-connection SMTP with automatic fallback (Gmail, Outlook, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, SparkPost, custom SMTP)
  • Test connection before saving
  • List-Unsubscribe headers + one-click unsubscribe footer for compliance

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Unlimited subscribers, 30 campaigns/month, 2 automation funnels, basic segmentation (lists & tags)
  • Pro: Unlimited campaigns, unlimited funnels, advanced segmentation (custom fields, behavior), A/B testing

📝 AI Content Generator (Free + Pro)

Write complete, SEO-optimized blog posts with one click using the AI content generator.

  • Generate full articles: title, introduction, structured body sections, and CTA
  • Per-section SEO analysis: keyword density and readability scoring
  • Configure word count, tone, target keyword, categories, and tags
  • Publish directly or save as WordPress draft
  • Scheduled publishing via WP-Cron
  • Save generation presets with custom brand voice settings
  • Article generation history and per-article stats

Free vs Pro

  • Free: 20 articles/month, up to 2,000 words
  • Pro: Unlimited articles, up to 5,000 words, custom presets, AI image prompt generation, multi-language content

🔍 SEO Analyzer (Free + Pro)

AI-powered SEO intelligence and on-page optimization without leaving WordPress. The SEO Analyzer module covers everything from keyword discovery to rank tracking — no separate SEO tool needed.

  • Keyword Research — Discover keyword opportunities with AI analysis
  • Keyword Vault — Save and manage keywords persistently (50 Free, Unlimited Pro)
  • On-Page SEO Audits — Audit any post or page; auto-audit triggers on post save
  • Site-Wide Batch Audits — Audit all posts at once (Pro)
  • Topical Authority Mapping — Build pillar + cluster content maps with visual coverage (Pro)
  • Content Calendar — Plan content around keyword targets (Pro)
  • Rank Tracking — Daily keyword rank checks with historical trend charts (Pro)
  • Link Building Pipeline — AI-powered outreach suggestions and prospect management (Pro)
  • Entity SEO & Schema — Structured data suggestions and competitor gap analysis (Pro)
  • Export — CSV and PDF export of all reports (Pro)

Free vs Pro

  • Free: 10 keyword searches/month, 50 keyword vault, 5 audits/month
  • Pro: Unlimited keywords, unlimited vault, unlimited audits, rank tracking, topical authority, competitor analysis

📱 Social Media Scheduler (Free + Pro)

Schedule and publish AI-generated social posts to Facebook, Instagram, and X/Twitter directly from WordPress.

  • Connect accounts via OAuth (Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter)
  • Compose and publish to one or multiple accounts simultaneously
  • AI caption generation optimized per platform
  • AI hashtag suggestions
  • 5-minute WP-Cron processing for reliable scheduled delivery
  • Visual drag-and-drop scheduling calendar (Pro)
  • Repurpose blog articles as social posts with one click (Pro)
  • Bulk upload and schedule multiple posts at once (Pro)
  • Engagement analytics: likes, comments, shares, reach, impressions

Free vs Pro

  • Free: 2 connected accounts, 30 posts/month, 3 scheduled posts
  • Pro: Unlimited accounts, unlimited posts, unlimited scheduled posts, visual calendar, AI repurposing, bulk scheduling

💬 AI Chatbot (Free + Pro)

Add an intelligent AI chatbot to your WordPress site for 24/7 customer support, lead capture, and visitor engagement.

  • Create and configure chatbot instances with a custom system prompt and personality
  • Customizable widget colors, position, and branding
  • Full conversation history in WordPress admin
  • Knowledge Base — Index documents, URLs, and WooCommerce products so the AI gives accurate site-specific answers (Pro)
  • Lead Capture — Configurable forms inside the chat widget; leads are automatically saved as subscribers in the Email module
  • Human Takeover — Escalate live conversations to a human agent (Pro)
  • Business Hours — Set availability windows and configure offline messages (Pro)
  • Custom CSS Theming — Full visual customization (Pro)
  • [aime_discussions] shortcode for a public discussions page
  • Visitor satisfaction rating and conversation analytics

Free vs Pro

  • Free: 1 chatbot, 100 conversations/month
  • Pro: Unlimited chatbots, unlimited conversations, knowledge base (docs, URLs, WooCommerce), human takeover, business hours, custom CSS

⚙️ Workflow Automation (Free + Pro)

Chain actions from every module into scheduled, automated marketing workflows — like a built-in Zapier for your marketing stack.

  • Visual workflow builder with step-by-step action chains
  • Cross-module actions: generate content, send campaigns, post to social media, and more
  • Schedule triggers (hourly, daily, weekly) and event triggers (new subscriber, post published, and more)
  • Run-now manual execution with per-step run history
  • Ready-made workflow templates to start from

Free vs Pro

  • Free: 2 active workflows, 3 steps per workflow, 30 runs/month
  • Pro: Unlimited workflows, unlimited steps, unlimited runs

🤖 Supported AI Providers

All modules share one AI provider system. Add as many connections as you need and assign them per module.

  • OpenAI (ChatGPT) — GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, o3-mini, GPT Image and more
  • Anthropic Claude — Claude 4 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Claude 3 Opus and more
  • Google AI Studio (Gemini) — Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemma 3 and more
  • OpenRouter — Access 200+ models through one API key (Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more)
  • Custom Provider — Any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible API endpoint

API keys are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with WordPress salt-derived keys. Keys can also be loaded from PHP constants or environment variables for production security.

🔒 Security & Privacy

  • All API keys and SMTP credentials are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM)
  • SSRF protection on all remote URL fetches
  • HMAC-signed email tracking links
  • No subscriber or visitor data is ever sent to third parties
  • Full compliance with WordPress coding standards and Plugin Check

📊 Unified Dashboard

The main AI Marketing dashboard shows:

  • Summary stats from all active modules
  • Per-module activity trend charts (7–90 day range)
  • Quick links to create campaigns, generate content, and manage subscribers

🔌 Integrations

  • Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, OpenRouter
  • SMTP providers: Gmail, Outlook, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, SparkPost, Custom
  • Facebook Pages, Instagram Business, X/Twitter
  • WordPress Posts, WooCommerce Products
  • WP-Cron for scheduled task execution

Privacy Policy

AI Marketing Expert connects to third-party external services to deliver its AI-powered features. By using those features you agree to the respective terms and privacy policies listed below.

AI Providers (used for content generation, chatbot responses, SEO analysis, social captions, and email copy)

When you use any AI-powered feature, the text you submit (article topic, keyword, chat message, email copy, etc.) is transmitted to the AI provider you configured in Settings → AI Providers. No data is transmitted unless you have added and selected a provider.

  • OpenAI — https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude) — https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
  • Google AI Studio (Gemini) — https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • OpenRouter — https://openrouter.ai/privacy

Social Media Platforms (used for the Social Media Scheduler module)

When you connect a social account and publish or schedule a post, the post content and your stored OAuth access token are transmitted to the respective platform API.

  • Meta (Facebook & Instagram) — https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
  • X / Twitter — https://twitter.com/en/privacy

What data is sent?

  • AI features: the text prompt or content you submit. No personal user data, subscriber emails, or visitor information is ever sent to AI providers.
  • Social posting: the post text, images, and your OAuth credentials for the connected account.
  • Email sending: email content is sent via the SMTP provider you configure. The plugin does not use or share any external email relay beyond the SMTP server you supply.

What data is stored locally?

  • Subscriber records, email addresses, campaign history, conversation transcripts, and SEO reports are stored only in your WordPress database on your own server.
  • API keys and SMTP passwords are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) in your WordPress database. They are never transmitted anywhere other than the respective provider API.

Data Retention

All data (subscribers, conversations, campaign history, audit reports) is stored on your server and is fully under your control. Deactivating or deleting the plugin will not automatically delete database tables — you can remove them from Settings before deletion.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Directory:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for AI Marketing Expert
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Click AI Marketing in the left admin menu to get started

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip and click Install Now
  4. Activate and go to AI Marketing in your admin menu

Setup:

  1. Go to AI Marketing → Settings → AI Providers and add at least one AI connection (Google AI Studio is free to start)
  2. Enable the modules you want from the Modules screen
  3. Configure each module from its submenu page
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an API key?

AI-powered features (content generation, AI subject lines, chatbot, SEO analysis, social captions) require an AI provider API key. You can use Google AI Studio (Gemini) which offers a free tier, or OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or OpenRouter. Non-AI features like SMTP email sending and subscriber management work without any API key.

Which AI provider should I start with?

Google AI Studio (Gemini) is the easiest to start with — it offers a free API tier with no credit card required. Sign up at ai.google.dev, create an API key, and paste it into AI Marketing → Settings → AI Providers.

Is the email marketing feature really free with unlimited subscribers?

Yes. The free tier includes unlimited subscribers and 30 campaigns per month. There is no subscriber cap on the free plan.

Does the chatbot work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The Pro plan allows you to index your WooCommerce product catalog into the chatbot knowledge base so it can answer product questions, check availability, and assist shoppers automatically.

Can I use multiple AI providers at the same time?

Yes. You can add multiple AI provider connections and assign different providers to different modules — for example, GPT-4o for content generation and Claude for your chatbot.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. All AI calls and email sending happen in the WordPress admin or via background WP-Cron jobs. The only front-end asset is the optional chatbot widget, which loads asynchronously.

Does the social media scheduler support LinkedIn?

Currently the plugin supports Facebook Pages, Instagram Business, and X/Twitter. LinkedIn support is planned for a future release.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All API keys and SMTP credentials are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption. No subscriber data or conversation data is ever sent to third parties. Email tracking uses HMAC-signed URLs to prevent open redirect abuse.

Can I import existing email subscribers?

Yes. You can import subscribers from a CSV file, sync from WordPress registered users, or import WooCommerce customers.

Where can I get support?

Visit wpthemespace.com/ai-marketing-expert for documentation and support.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Fixed: Email Footer issue
  • Fixed: Email A/B Test Subject B loading spinner
  • Fixed: chatbot Now only counts actual visitor messages.
  • Fixed: Automation double email bug issue fixed
  • Fixed: chatbot widget not displaying on mobile devices due to CSS transform breaking position:fixed full-screen layout.
  • Added: translate .pot file

1.2.0

  • New: Workflow Automation module for connecting and orchestrating marketing tasks.
  • New: stock image support in the Content Generator module.
  • New: API token and usage price counters.
  • New: multi-provider continuation — when an AI provider stops mid-article (token cap or rate limit), the next connected provider finishes the remaining part instead of the whole generation failing. Sites with a single connection retry the same provider after its cooldown during background runs.
  • Improved: truncated AI responses are now detected (Google, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, custom providers) instead of being saved as half-written articles.
  • Improved: redesigned dashboard and module UI.
  • Improved: smooth loading animations throughout the admin interface.
  • Fixed: various issues and errors in all Modules.

1.1.1

  • Fixed: campaign recipient count could double mid-send under concurrent processing (duplicate emails). Added a unique constraint on the send queue and a one-time de-duplication migration.
  • Fixed: paused campaigns that were still resolving their audience could not be paused reliably.
  • New: “End Campaign” button to fully stop an in-progress campaign and view its final status.
  • New (Pro): provider feedback-loop webhooks to auto-move spam complaints to the Complaint list and hard bounces to the Bounced list.
    Point your ESP (Amazon SES via SNS, SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark) at:

    • Complaints: POST {site}/wp-json/aime/v1/email/webhook/complaint
    • Bounces: POST {site}/wp-json/aime/v1/email/webhook/bounce
      Authenticate with your API key (generate under Settings → API), body: { “email”: “user@example.com” } or { “emails”: [“a@x.com”,”b@y.com”] }.
  • Improved: added List-Unsubscribe-Post (one-click unsubscribe) header for better deliverability.

1.1.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org
  • Email Marketing module: unlimited subscribers, 30 campaigns/month on free tier
  • Content Generator module: AI article generation with SEO analysis
  • SEO Analyzer module: keyword research, vault, rank tracking, and on-page audits
  • Social Media module: Facebook, Instagram, and X/Twitter scheduling
  • Chatbot module: AI customer support with lead capture
  • Multi-provider AI layer: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter
  • AES-256-CBC encryption for all API keys and SMTP credentials
  • Hardened security: SSRF protection, HMAC-signed tracking URLs, secure OAuth flow
  • React-based unified admin dashboard
